name: devfoundation

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @devfoundation/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @devfoundation/contracts" "npm run dev -w @devfoundation/api" "npm run dev -w @devfoundation/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @devfoundation/contracts && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @devfoundation/contracts && npm run test -ws --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build -w @devfoundation/contracts && npm run build -w @devfoundation/api && npm run build -w @devfoundation/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:cli && npm run build

description: Beginner-friendly React, Express and TypeScript full-stack project starter with optional PostgreSQL and Notes tutorial.
